name: markup-to-docs
title: Markup to Docs
description: Create PDF, DOCX, ODT, and RTF files from AI-provided HTML and CSS.
author: shaynelarocque

commands.name: markup-to-docs
commands.title: Markup to Docs
commands.description: Manually create PDF, DOCX, ODT, or RTF from HTML/CSS files.

tools.name: generate-document
tools.title: Generate Document
tools.description: Create a PDF, DOCX, ODT, or RTF file from HTML/CSS and an output directory.

ai.instructions: Use generate-document whenever the user asks to produce a PDF, DOCX, ODT, or RTF document. Always pass html, fileType (pdf, docx, odt, or rtf), and outputDirectory. Pass css and fileName when useful.
